title: Risk Control Certifies Rates, Not Magnitudes: An Audit of Selective Fetal Biometry
abstract: arXiv:2611.05851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prenatal ultrasound biometry must return a head circumference (HC) and refuse when the image cannot support one. Selective prediction trades coverage against error, but its finite-sample guarantees bound the rate of gross errors, not their magnitude. We audit a tool-grounded biometry pipeline on two separately pre-registered four-way splits of the 999 labelled HC18 images, retraining the segmenter three times on each. Calibrating the contour-completeness threshold by exact Clopper-Pearson risk control returns a certificate indistinguishable from a hand-set floor, yet the pipeline still emits a 271.3 mm error: a small, geometrically complete ring fitted to an image whose true HC is 324.6 mm. The accepted candidate scores 0.94 completeness, so the score cannot see the failure, and one outlier among $\approx 150$ answers leaves the certified risk bound ($\alpha = 0.10$) intact. translated_title: 风险控制认证的是错误率而非错误幅度：对选择性胎儿生物测量的审计
translated_abstract: 产前超声生物测量必须返回头围（HC）数值，并在图像无法支持该测量时拒绝给出结果。选择性预测以覆盖范围换取错误率，但其有限样本保证仅约束了严重错误的发生率，而非错误的幅度。我们在两个分别预先注册的、对999张标注的HC18图像进行的四路划分上，审计了一个基于工具的生物测量流程，并在每次划分上对分割器进行三次重训练。通过精确的Clopper-Pearson风险控制来校准轮廓完整度阈值，所得的认证证书与手工设定的底线并无区别，但该流程仍然输出了一个271.3毫米的误差：一个几何上完整的小圆环被拟合到了真实头围为324.6毫米的图像上。被接受的候选结果完整度得分高达0.94，因此该评分无法察觉此次失败，而在约150个答案中的一个离群值也使认证的风险界限（α = 0.10）保持完好。第二个未经改动的划分在不同的（文本在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文审计了选择性胎儿头围测量流程，揭示风险控制仅能认证严重错误的发生率而非错误幅度——即使满足认证风险界限，系统仍可输出高达53毫米的巨大误差，且该失败被0.94的高完整度评分完全掩盖。
en_tdlr: This audit of a selective fetal head-circumference biometry pipeline shows that risk control certifies only the rate—not the magnitude—of gross errors, as a geometrically complete prediction scoring 0.94 completeness emits a 271.3 mm error on a 324.6 mm image while a single outlier leaves the certified risk bound (α = 0.10) intact.
